findings: All five sample answers need editorial tightening: remove source-reading narration (la ficha dice, la norma que revisé), unprompted comparisons and long research caveats. Keep 1–3 short visitor-focused sentences with actionable next step; put legal history in detail/log.

demanding_south has wrong grammatical person antes de comprometerme a la cumbre and a long disclaimer about what the assistant will not do. Replace with direct preparation/guide advice supported by source.

Several examples are artificial declarative filler: no son la laguna verde, el camino de Anzoátegui no es Brisas, la ficha dice que hay que prepararse, dulima es montaña de verdad. Replace throughout all 73 entries with natural visitor queries; each example must be a plausible request, not an authored factual contrast.

picnic_on_trail example dejo la basura del almuerzo en un punto belongs to rules.leave_no_waste. Reassign/remove the cross-scope positive; absence of picnic listing does not establish no physical picnic area.

victor_mariposa_lagoons includes route-position and current-opening examples; answer should describe the visit and explicitly condition current availability without imply all listed 2023 trails remain open.
vehicle_or_on_foot overlaps access and asserts park has no general internal transport based on absence. Keep activity format distinction supported by source, and do not infer transport nonexistence.

Scope audit: activities.induction_talk requirement belongs booking_fees; activities.luggage_portage as a service belongs services. Physical sector enumeration and proposed management sectors belong geography. Merge/reassign after cross-section audit.

Named absent offers (boat, ski, night hike, refuge, duration gap) can be useful visitor questions but must not become claimed prohibitions or many near-identical no-information entries. Merge when answers and retrieval intents are effectively the same.
Dynamic restrictions and camping: preserve all material date/permission caveats in variants, not only short/log. Do not treat a 2026 proposal or future-tense press announcement as an opened trail.
resolved_from_existing_evidence: The saved PNN page explicitly says the park does not provide internal transport, and transport/portage must be organized independently or with registered operators. This factual claim is supported; only streamline presentation/scope.
